a4a8f7dd1b875cf1.description: About the Role Baazeem Trading Company is seeking an ERP & System Administrator to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing and supporting the company's IT infrastructure and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (BC365) ERP environment. The administrator will be responsible for ensuring system availability, security, performance, and business continuity across all company locations. Key Responsibilities Administer, maintain, and optimize the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (BC365) ERP system. Install, configure, and maintain Windows servers, databases, virtualization platforms, and network infrastructure. Manage Microsoft 365 services, Active Directory, cloud services, and user accounts. Monitor system performance and troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and ERP-related issues. Plan and execute system upgrades, patches, and infrastructure improvements. Perform and monitor backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures to ensure business continuity. Maintain database performance, storage capacity, and system security. Lead IT support and helpdesk activities, ensuring timely resolution of user issues. Implement cybersecurity best practices, endpoint protection, and access control. Prepare technical documentation, system configurations, and IT procedures. Coordinate with external vendors for hardware, software, licenses, and technical support. Required Experience Candidates should possess 3-5 years of relevant experience in ERP administration and IT system management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, supporting IT infrastructure across all company locations.

a4b3de2d33cc17ba.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs safe and sustainable transport solutions worldwide, contributing to social inclusion and access to essential services. For 65 years, SYSTRA has partnered with cities and regions to develop, improve, and modernize infrastructure and transport systems across the entire project lifecycle, from design to maintenance. Operating in over 80 countries, SYSTRA supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions to innovate future mobility. The Opportunity SYSTRA is seeking a Structural Engineer with significant expertise in steel structures to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting PMC (Project Management Consultancy) delivery on a metro station or major building project. The Structural Engineer will be responsible for overseeing structural design reviews, contractor submittals, construction activities, and technical interfaces, ensuring compliance with project requirements, applicable codes, quality standards, and approved schedules. Key Responsibilities Review and assess structural designs, calculations, drawings, specifications, method statements, and material submittals, with a specific focus on steel structures. Monitor contractor and consultant design development, providing technical comments and tracking responses to resolution. Oversee structural works on site, including steel frames, long-span roofs, canopies, platforms, connections, and related building or station elements. Verify that construction aligns with approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes, and quality requirements. Coordinate structural interfaces with architectural, civil, MEP, rail systems, and other project disciplines. Review inspection and test plans, quality records, technical queries, non-conformance reports, and proposed corrective actions. Identify design, constructability, sequencing, and interface risks; recommend practical solutions and escalate critical issues. Monitor progress against the program, identify potential delays, and support timely resolution of technical and construction issues. Participate in technical meetings, site inspections, design workshops, and project progress reviews. Maintain clear records of reviews, observations, approvals, and outstanding actions, and provide reports to the PMC project leadership. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage. At least 10 years of relevant structural engineering experience, including demonstrable project experience in Saudi Arabia. Experience in a PMC, supervision consultant, or similar client-side role. Relevant experience on a metro station, railway infrastructure, or major building project. Strong technical expertise in the analysis, design review, and construction of steel structures. Working knowledge of relevant Saudi requirements and applicable international structural design standards. Proficiency in reviewing structural calculations and drawings; familiarity with tools such as ETABS, SAP2000, ******, or Tekla is an advantage. Strong communication, coordination, reporting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

a4bd3cc86c35d9fa.description: About Sacoor Brothers Sacoor Brothers is an international lifestyle brand established in 1989, offering men's, women's, and children's clothing, footwear, and accessories. With 37 years of experience in the fashion business, the company operates through its network of stores and has gained recognition in its markets. The Role: E-commerce Senior Specialist Sacoor Brothers is expanding its online sales in Saudi Arabia and is seeking an E-commerce Senior Specialist to manage its online store in Riyadh. This full-time role involves working with both the local KSA team and the regional e-commerce team in Dubai, directly contributing to online sales growth. Key Responsibilities Drive online sales growth in KSA and manage key performance indicators including traffic, conversion rates, and average order value. Oversee the daily operations of the online store, including product listings, pricing, stock management, content updates, and promotions. Plan and execute online campaigns and seasonal sales in collaboration with the marketing department and external agencies. Optimize the customer journey from search to checkout and delivery to ensure a smooth and simple experience. Collaborate with logistics and customer service teams to ensure fast delivery, efficient returns, and customer satisfaction. Prepare and share a concise weekly report detailing results and identifying areas for improvement. Contribute to the implementation of the 2027 e-commerce strategy for Saudi Arabia. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in e-commerce or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage online store operations and drive sales. Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and online campaign execution. Benefits A competitive compensation package. Medical insurance. Opportunity for direct ownership of a growing sales channel. Collaboration with a regional e-commerce team across the GCC. Potential for career growth within an international brand. Application Sacoor Brothers values individuals who are passionate about e-commerce and committed to building a significant presence in Saudi Arabia. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

a4cac3a8a2700e29.description: About the Role Sadara Chemical Company is seeking a Sourcing Specialist II SMP to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern Region. This full-time position is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on implementing sourcing plans and supporting procurement activities for materials and services. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to execute Sadara's material and services sourcing plans. This involves supporting procurement and contracting activities by identifying and engaging vendors, streamlining bidding processes, mitigating risks, and optimizing value in terms of quality, delivery, and cost effectiveness. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement Sadara’s sourcing strategies, policies, and procedures for materials and services, including spot buying and forward agreements, in collaboration with relevant personnel. Initiate purchase orders and long-term purchase agreements for materials and services, encompassing warehousing agreements with local suppliers, direct delivery agreements, low-value agreements, and vendor-managed inventory. Review market conditions and material costs to provide recommendations for future sourcing plans. Maintain a balanced portfolio of long-term contracts and short-term agreements to support strategic changes while minimizing procurement costs. Coordinate with various Sadara organizations and personnel to identify and analyze their material and service procurement requirements and technical specifications. Facilitate interactions between the function/department/division and suppliers to resolve issues related to specification changes, pricing, or other technical matters. Participate in the development of specifications for equipment, products, or substitute materials to manage potential supply scarcities. Cultivate and maintain effective relationships with both domestic and international vendors. Collect and maintain information and records pertaining to vendors’ credit status, financial performance, and other relevant data to monitor and evaluate their capacity to meet Sadara’s material and service needs. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for the Sourcing Specialist II SMP role should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. The role requires a foundational understanding of sourcing principles and procurement processes. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, within the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia. The role involves coordination across various internal departments and external suppliers, operating within a structured corporate environment. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to contribute to Sadara Chemical Company's sourcing and procurement objectives.

a47b82c740c6ef12.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة رياض المملكة للتجارة والمقاولات عن حاجتها لـ مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة عمليات تطوير خطط التنفيذ، ومراقبة سير العمل لضمان تحقيق الأهداف ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه عمليات تقدير الموازنات وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، مع ضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وبتكلفة تقديرية. متابعة عمليات تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع المشاريع والبرامج الأخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد المتاحة، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق عمل المشروع لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارته المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وإغلاقه، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والنماذج والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. متطلبات الخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، مع القدرة على الإشراف على فرق العمل وتوجيهها نحو تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المؤهلات والمهارات فهم عميق لمبادئ وعمليات إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ الخطط الاستراتيجية للمشاريع. مهارات ممتازة في إدارة الموارد والميزانيات. القدرة على تحديد المخاطر ووضع حلول فعالة لها. مهارات تواصل وتنسيق عالية مع مختلف الأطراف المعنية. القدرة على إعداد وتقديم التقارير الدورية للإدارة العليا. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة رياض المملكة للتجارة والمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

a4f218e7b9a1856c.description: About the Role: Vice Principal Pastoral أعناب is seeking a Vice Principal Pastoral to join an international school in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading student wellbeing, safeguarding, behaviour, and pastoral care for upper primary and secondary students. The Vice Principal Pastoral will report directly to the Principal and oversee the daily management of students and a diverse pastoral team. Role Context and Collaboration The successful candidate will work closely with the Vice Principal Academics, heads of department, and teachers. This collaboration is essential to maintain high academic and behavioural standards and to ensure that students receive the necessary support to succeed. The position requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Lead, implement, and regularly review the school's pastoral care, safeguarding, behaviour, and anti-bullying policies and procedures. Monitor student attendance, punctuality, behaviour, wellbeing, and academic progress. Coordinate timely interventions for students requiring additional support or at risk of exclusion. Oversee individual behaviour and pastoral support plans, assess their impact, and collaborate with academic and learning support teams to remove barriers to learning. Serve as a primary point of contact for students, parents, and staff regarding pastoral matters, and liaise with external agencies as appropriate. Oversee the investigation, documentation, and reporting of student incidents in accordance with school policies and relevant Ministry of Education procedures. Develop staff practice in pastoral care, manage pastoral resources, and support student transitions, leadership opportunities, and enrichment activities. Foster a safe, inclusive, and respectful school culture that aligns with the school's vision and Islamic ethos. Experience and Location Candidates should possess over 10 years of experience in a related educational leadership role. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Further details regarding the salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

a4c095cf700377aa.description: We are looking for an experienced Invoice & Return Supervisor to oversee invoice processing and return operations within our Distribution Center. The role is responsible for ensuring accurate invoice verification, efficient return handling, inventory reconciliation, and discrepancy resolution while maintaining compliance with operational and financial control procedures. Key Responsibilities Supervise invoice verification and processing, ensuring accuracy against purchase orders, receiving records, quantities, and supporting documents. Oversee return receiving, verification, classification, and processing to ensure proper documentation and inventory updates. Monitor and reconcile physical stock, invoices, receiving records, return documents, and system transactions. Investigate and resolve invoice, quantity, inventory, and return discrepancies in coordination with relevant departments. Supervise and coordinate the Invoice & Returns team, allocate tasks, monitor performance, and provide guidance and training. Ensure returned products are properly segregated and transferred according to approved procedures. Prepare operational reports and monitor KPIs related to processing accuracy, pending transactions, and discrepancy levels. Maintain accurate documentation and support internal and external audits. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5–7 years of relevant experience in warehouse operations, inbound, returns, inventory control, or invoice processing, including supervisory experience. Good knowledge of invoice verification, receiving, returns management, and warehouse documentation. Strong understanding of inventory reconciliation, stock movements, and discrepancy management. Experience using Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and ERP systems. Previous experience supervising operational teams in a fast-paced warehouse environment. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills. Good reporting and documentation skills. Relevant certifications in Supply Chain, Inventory Management, Warehouse Operations, or Logistics are preferred.

a411fe7cfc16490a.description: About the Role ACWA Operations is seeking experienced Mechanical Engineers for upcoming full-time opportunities in Yanbu and Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. These roles will support operations across RO desalination and CCGT power plants. Role Purpose The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for planning, supervising, and improving mechanical maintenance activities. The primary objective is to ensure equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and safe plant performance, adhering to approved maintenance plans, OEM requirements, and HSE standards. Key Responsibilities Plan and supervise preventive, corrective, and predictive mechanical maintenance activities to ensure equipment reliability and plant availability. Oversee maintenance and troubleshooting for a range of mechanical equipment, including pumps, compressors, turbines, valves, and piping systems. Provide technical support for RO desalination equipment, such as high-pressure pumps and energy recovery systems, or CCGT equipment, including gas and steam turbines, HRSGs, condensers, and mechanical auxiliaries. Coordinate mechanical inspections, equipment overhauls, planned outages, and specialist maintenance activities with Operations and OEM representatives. Analyze equipment failures, vibration, lubrication, alignment, and inspection findings; conduct root-cause analysis and recommend reliability improvements. Manage maintenance work orders through CMMS/SAP, maintain technical documentation, and coordinate maintenance planning, spare parts, and procurement requirements. Supervise mechanical maintenance personnel, provide technical guidance, and support employee development and performance management. Ensure compliance with HSE requirements, Integrated Management System (IMS) standards, and applicable legal and contractual obligations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in mechanical engineering roles. Experience in RO desalination or CCGT power plants is required. Work Environment This is a plant-based position located in Saudi Arabia. The role involves coordination with Operations, maintenance teams, contractors, and OEM representatives to ensure seamless plant performance.

a45540209588591e.description: About Accor Accor operates with a commitment to business ethics, integrity, responsible tourism, sustainable development, community outreach, and diversity and inclusion. The company fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace that values the contributions of all team members. With a broad portfolio of hotels and brands, Accor offers opportunities for career advancement and professional development. Role Summary Accor is seeking a Finance Manager for a full-time position in Yanbu. This senior role involves ensuring the timely compilation of accurate financial management reports in accordance with local tax regulations, corporate requirements, and owner specifications. The Finance Manager will also be responsible for implementing and maintaining proper internal controls and leading the development of the accounting staff through training and cross-training initiatives to meet the hotel’s operational and cultural needs. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Ensure all accounting colleagues understand and adhere to company accounting policies and procedures, particularly those related to country-specific tax rules and regulations. Monitor daily routines of the accounting department to ensure effective, efficient, and tax-compliant work practices. Supervise and assist with account reconciliations, account analysis, and month-end closing procedures. Verify the accuracy of all night audit transactions in terms of applicable tax rules and monitor adherence to established procedures for all hotel department purchases and sales. Oversee the filing and maintenance of all tax accounting-related documents and records in accordance with local document retention regulations and Hotel Management Agreement provisions. Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of all operational financial reporting to both FRHI and the Owner. Plan, educate, and audit departmental and hotel staff involved in ordering goods or signing tax-related documents. Oversee the training, cross-training, and development of hotel staff on all local taxation issues. Lead forecasting, reporting, budgeting, internal control, and account analysis. Prepare all financial statements, accruals, and journal entries, and maintain reconciliations for all balance sheet accounts related to taxation, following corporate formats and generally accepted accounting principles. Supervise and ensure all reports and documents comply with IFRS, the latest edition of the Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry, and Hotel Management Agreement requirements. Maintain thorough knowledge of all tax-related documents and laws in the country and monitor all changes. Lead the preparation of all budgets and forecasts. Supervise the day-to-day activities of Accounting staff, providing assistance as needed. Prepare or oversee the preparation of all local, state, and other tax filings, returns, and reporting on a timely basis, to the extent of the operating company's responsibility. Participate in and develop staff training programs to minimize colleague turnover and ensure effective Accounting office operations. Conduct self professionally at all times and encourage staff to reflect the high standards of the brand. Required Qualifications and Skills Thorough knowledge of all jobs within the Accounting areas. Commitment to following all local and corporate policies and procedures. High degree of professional integrity and confidentiality. Ability to work in a safe, prudent, and organized manner. 5-10 years of experience in a relevant finance or accounting role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Yanbu, offering scope for impact and growth for an ambitious applicant within a supportive and inclusive workplace culture. Application Process Candidates interested in this opportunity are encouraged to apply.

a4ac71ab1263001c.description: About Bupa Arabia Bupa Arabia is seeking a Manager - Clinical Excellence to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on managing inpatient cases throughout the care journey, ensuring clinical appropriateness, high quality, patient-centered care, and cost efficiency. Key Responsibilities Apply evidence-based clinical guidelines and protocols to inpatient cases. Conduct clinical case reviews for medical necessity and appropriateness. Manage complex and high-risk cases, escalating as required. Assess care pathways, quality of care, and outcomes across internal and external care channels. Conduct medical FIs and hospital profiling. Patient-Centric Service Management Apply patient- and member-centric principles in clinical care management processes. Balance clinical appropriateness, cost efficiency, and customer experience in care decisions. Conduct proactive engagement with high-risk and chronic patients to improve experience and outcomes. Coordinate with onsite and third-party providers on quality checks and documentation, addressing failures promptly. Support third-party customer relationship management programs. Utilization and Cost Management Review admission appropriateness and level of care. Review inpatient utilization promptly, within agreed standards of the inpatient end-to-end management program. Monitor length of stay and support discharge planning. Identify high-cost cases and recommend interventions and cost-containment initiatives. Audit and report fraud, coding abuse, and non-compliance with coding standards. Onsite Adjudication and Quality Assurance Verify, audit, and report all inpatient services incurred. Review and process inpatient claims onsite against medical policy, line items, invoices, and adjudication guidelines, cross-checking physical and electronic claims data. Apply medical judgment and agreement terms and conditions to prevent abuse, fraud, and overtreatment. Escalate high-profile and high-value claims for decision. Coordinate with hospitals to resolve inpatient claim issues. Apply quality standards across clinical care management. Conduct clinical quality assurance and quality control checks. Monitor adherence to clinical guidelines, protocols, and regulatory requirements. Track quality indicators in daily operations and recommend improvements that standardize clinical practice. Document clinical decisions to support audit and compliance. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time position are encouraged to apply.

a4bde565240ce5a6.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is seeking an HPC Storage Specialist to join their team in Thuwal, Makkah. This full-time role involves the design, deployment, operation, and lifecycle management of enterprise and research-scale data storage platforms. The specialist will support the Shaheen-3 Secure Landing Zone environment and the Research Data Management initiative, covering a full spectrum of storage technologies for research workloads, instrument data pipelines, and HPC-adjacent storage needs. Key Responsibilities Administer, monitor, and optimize scale-out NAS platforms (*, Dell PowerScale, Qumulo, VAST Data, PureStorage) for multi-petabyte research datasets, including capacity planning, performance tuning, quota and share management, and firmware/software lifecycle management. Operate and maintain SAN infrastructure (*, PureStorage, Fibre Channel, iSCSI/NVMe-oF), managing fabric zoning, LUN provisioning, multipathing, and integration with virtualization and database platforms. Deploy and support software-defined storage solutions (*, Ceph, ZFS-based systems, MinIO/object storage) tailored for research use cases. Manage the enterprise backup and data protection environment, including backup policies, replication, snapshots, immutability/ransomware protection, restore testing, and archive/tiering strategies. Automate provisioning, configuration, monitoring, and reporting workflows using Infrastructure-as-Code and automation tools (*, Ansible, Terraform, Python, storage platform REST APIs). Build monitoring, alerting, and capacity/performance dashboards (*, Prometheus/Grafana) with automated health checks. Contribute to storage architecture decisions and technology evaluations, assessing vendor appliance-based and software-defined approaches based on performance, cost, operability, and risk. Define and implement data lifecycle management, including tiering between performance, capacity, and archive storage, retention policies, and migration of large research datasets. Implement storage security controls such as access control (NFS/SMB/S3 permissions, Kerberos/AD integration), encryption at rest and in transit, audit logging, and least-privilege administration; maintain accurate configuration documentation. Act as a Tier 2/3 escalation point for storage-related incidents and service requests, coordinating with vendors on support cases, upgrades, and hardware RMA processes. Consult with researchers to translate scientific data requirements into suitable storage solutions; mentor junior staff and document knowledge. Perform occasional data center work (racking equipment, structured cabling) and participate in scheduled maintenance windows outside business hours and in an on-call rotation. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of hands-on experience in enterprise storage engineering/administration. Demonstrated production experience with scale-out NAS platforms such as Qumulo, VAST Data, Dell PowerScale (Isilon), or NetApp. Solid experience with SAN/block storage technologies (Fibre Channel fabrics, iSCSI, NVMe-oF) and at least one major SAN vendor ecosystem. Experience with enterprise backup solutions (*, Veeam, Commvault, NetBackup, Rubrik), including the design of backup/restore and disaster recovery strategies. Essential Skills Strong Linux systems administration skills (RHEL/Rocky/Ubuntu), including storage-related subsystems (LVM, filesystems, NFS/SMB clients, multipathing). Proven automation skills: scripting (Python and/or Bash) and IaC/configuration management (Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent), including the use of storage platform APIs. Understanding of storage networking (Ethernet/RDMA, Fibre Channel), protocols (NFS, SMB, S3, block), and performance analysis. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across the storage stack (hardware, network, OS, protocol, application). Automation-first mindset with a bias toward repeatable, documented, and testable operations. Ability to pragmatically balance vendor appliance-based and software-defined approaches based on requirements. Clear written and verbal communication in English; able to explain technical trade-offs to researchers and management. Collaborative, service-oriented attitude in a multicultural, international environment. Preferred Skills Relevant certifications (vendor storage certifications, RHCSA/RHCE, cloud certifications) are a plus. Experience supporting research environments or other large-scale, data-intensive workloads is preferred. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Thuwal, Makkah, at KAUST. The role involves working within a demanding research community and requires a collaborative approach to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable storage services.

a4f578802e022e24.description: About the Role Afaq Q Tech General Trading is seeking an Instock Manager, Strategic Initiatives, MENA to join the A-Now team in Riyadh. a4f686c89428bb21.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المعمر لأنظمة المعلومات عن مطور تطبيقات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم وتطوير وصيانة حلول التطبيقات لتلبية متطلبات العملاء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تطوير التطبيقات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فهم خطط تصميم التطبيقات وإعداد خطط مفصلة لكتابة الأكواد البرمجية واختبارها، مع تحديد الإطار الزمني ومراحل التنفيذ. تطوير الأكواد البرمجية للتطبيقات باستخدام لغات البرمجة المناسبة، وتجميعها في برامج تنفيذية جاهزة للاستخدام. نشر التطبيقات على أجهزة العملاء وتنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى اختبار المنتج وإجراء التشغيل التجريبي للتأكد من كفاءته. توثيق جميع إجراءات تطوير التطبيقات بشكل دقيق، مما يسهل التحديثات والتغييرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في تطوير التطبيقات. فهم قوي لمفاهيم تصميم وتطوير وصيانة التطبيقات. القدرة على كتابة الأكواد البرمجية واختبارها بكفاءة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة المعمر لأنظمة المعلومات في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المطور ضمن بيئة داعمة تركز على تقديم حلول تقنية عالية الجودة للعملاء. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا كمطور تطبيقات، يرجى تقديم طلبكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

a43b26e0dfa9efb3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اوتاد الذوق للمقاولات المعمارية عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. تتاح هذه الفرصة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف ضمن فريق مؤسسة اوتاد الذوق للمقاولات المعمارية في مدينة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل، مع التركيز على تنفيذ المهام الفنية بكفاءة ودقة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

a4287a069b1c8101.description: About 2P Perfect Presentation Since 2004, 2P Perfect Presentation has been a prominent leader in Saudi Arabia’s ICT sector. The company specializes in delivering integrated technology solutions designed to accelerate digital transformation and enhance operational efficiency for organizations. With a strong foundation in innovation and service excellence, 2P provides end-to-end solutions through its specialized business units and established market expertise. The Role: Senior Database Specialist 2P Perfect Presentation is seeking a Senior Database Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience in database administration, with a strong focus on Microsoft SQL Server. The specialist will be responsible for supporting, maintaining, monitoring, and optimizing database environments to ensure availability, performance, security, reliability, and data integrity. Key Responsibilities Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server database environments. Monitor database performance, availability, capacity, and overall health. Write, maintain, and troubleshoot T-SQL queries. Perform SQL performance tuning and query optimization. Manage database backup, recovery, and routine maintenance activities. Support and maintain SQL Server Always On Availability Groups. Manage database users, roles, permissions, and access controls. Support database security requirements, including data masking and encryption. Monitor and troubleshoot database incidents and performance issues. Support SQL Server Agent Jobs and scheduled database activities. Provide basic support for SSIS packages and related processes. Support PostgreSQL database environments when required. Perform regular database health checks and preventive maintenance. Maintain accurate technical documentation and operational procedures. Coordinate with application, infrastructure, and technical teams to resolve database-related issues. Required Qualifications and Experience 2–3 years of experience in Database Administration. Demonstrated hands-on knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server. Experience with T-SQL queries and performance tuning. Knowledge of database backup, recovery, and maintenance procedures. Familiarity with SQL Server Always On Availability Groups. Experience in database security and user access management. Basic knowledge of SSIS and SQL Server Agent Jobs. Basic knowledge of data masking and encryption. Familiarity with PostgreSQL. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Good documentation skills, including maintaining technical documentation and operational procedures. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Senior Database Specialist will work within a technical team, collaborating with various departments including application and infrastructure teams to ensure robust database operations.

a442be3cd691c3d3.description: About the Role We are seeking a Network Security Engineer to join our team in Abha. This full-time role involves configuring, managing, and monitoring network security systems, analyzing security events, and participating in incident response. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and includes shared responsibilities with a Network Engineer to support enterprise networks and manage Cisco ISE configurations. Key Responsibilities Configure, manage, and monitor firewalls, VPNs, and IDS/IPS systems, and enforce access policies to protect network traffic. Analyze security events, alerts, and logs; investigate and respond to incidents, and participate in digital forensics and incident response. Conduct and coordinate vulnerability assessments and authorized security testing, with familiarity with ethical hacking methods and vulnerability assessment tools, and follow up on closing observations. Utilize network security and analysis tools such as Wireshark, Metasploit, Nmap, and Nessus within the scope of approved operations. Analyze TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, SSL/TLS, and VPN communications and protocols, identifying risks or causes of related security incidents. Implement security hardening for Windows and Linux systems and strengthen their security configurations, coordinating updates and patches. Understand and apply appropriate data protection and encryption mechanisms, including AES, RSA, and TLS, according to system requirements. Contribute to implementing Zero Trust principles and securing SD-WAN environments, reviewing secure access design. Prepare reports on risks, incidents, vulnerabilities, and corrective actions, and document security settings and changes. Shared Network Engineering Tasks Support the operation of LAN and WLAN enterprise networks and inter-site connectivity, and solutions for wireless infrastructure, security, identity, and data protection. Work on configurations for Switching and Routing devices, assess network and access policies, and analyze connectivity and performance issues. Configure and manage Cisco ISE and access control policies, document design and configurations, and troubleshoot authentication and authorization issues. Handle advanced Cisco ISE scenarios such as Posture Assessment, NAM Module, Profiling, MDM Integration, and Guest Access, integrating with relevant identity systems. Coordinate with server and supporting services administrators such as Active Directory when needed to integrate identity and network security solutions. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in network security or a related field, demonstrating proficiency in the responsibilities outlined above. A strong understanding of network protocols, security systems, and incident response procedures is essential. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Abha. The role requires on-site presence to manage and support network security infrastructure effectively. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

a443c23ba5f87552.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة داتيكس لحلول الاعمال عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء علاقات مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التحصيلات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مندوب المبيعات مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وخدمة العملاء بفعالية. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات التي تقدمها الشركة. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع توثيق بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء المحتملين والحاليين، سواء عبر الهاتف أو الزيارات الميدانية، لتقديم عروض البيع. شرح مواصفات المنتجات وميزاتها التنافسية للعملاء بوضوح. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة. إتمام عمليات البيع، تحرير الفواتير، وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، تسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا الدور، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع البيانات وتحليلها. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات في بيئة ديناميكية تركز على تحقيق الأهداف في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والعمل ضمن فريق مبيعات متخصص. التقديم إذا كنت تمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة وتتطلع للانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة داتيكس لحلول الاعمال، ندعوك للتقديم على هذا الدور.

a4db2ae573ee4c2c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دينورا عن موظف مبيعات سعودي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر. يركز هذا الدور على بيع خدمات التسويق الرقمي وحلول الأعمال للشركات والمشاريع، ويشمل البحث عن عملاء جدد ومتابعة فرص البيع من التواصل الأولي حتى إتمام الصفقة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات. نظام العمل والتعويض تعتمد هذه الفرصة على نظام العمل الحر (Freelance) بنظام العمولة فقط، دون راتب ثابت. تُحتسب العمولة كنسبة متفق عليها من قيمة الصفقات التي ينجح موظف المبيعات في إغلاقها. سيتم توضيح نسبة العمولة وشروط استحقاقها ومواعيد صرفها بشكل كامل قبل بدء التعاون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية البحث عن الشركات والمشاريع المحتملة التي يمكن أن تستفيد من خدمات دينورا، والتواصل الفعال مع أصحاب القرار فيها. ترتيب وعقد اجتماعات تعريفية مع العملاء لفهم احتياجاتهم وتقديم الخدمات المناسبة لهم. تنسيق إعداد عروض الأسعار مع الفريق المختص، ومتابعتها مع العملاء، والتفاوض لإغلاق الصفقات بنجاح. توثيق جميع مراحل التواصل والبيع، وتقديم تحديثات أسبوعية حول الاجتماعات، العروض، والصفقات المحتملة أو المنجزة. تنسيق عملية تسليم العميل الجديد إلى فريق التنفيذ بعد إبرام العقد. المؤهلات والخبرات سعودي الجنسية. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على البحث عن عملاء جدد وبناء علاقات مهنية. مهارات تواصل وتفاوض ممتازة. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الخبر بالمملكة العربية السعودية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

a4a93af15e2d98bf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اوتاد الذوق للمقاولات المعمارية عن فني ميكاترونيكس للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات تركيب آلات الميكاترونيكس، وتحديد قطع الغيار، وتحميل البرامج، ومتابعة الصيانة الوقائية، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات تركيب آلات الميكاترونيكس، مثل آلات النجارة المبرمجة وآلات المصانع الغذائية، ومتابعة إجراءات تركيبها وفقًا لأدلة التركيب. تحديد قائمة قطع الغيار الاحتياطية اللازمة لآلات الميكاترونيكس والعمل على تأمينها. تحميل برامج التشغيل والبرامج التطبيقية الخاصة بآلات الميكاترونيكس وإجراء التشغيل التجريبي. متابعة إجراءات الصيانة الوقائية وتشخيص الأعطال باستخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس، والعمل على إصلاحها وضبطها. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الميكاترونيكس أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية. معرفة ببرامج التشغيل والتطبيقات الخاصة بآلات الميكاترونيكس. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في نجران، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة اوتاد الذوق للمقاولات المعمارية. يتطلب الدور العمل المباشر مع آلات الميكاترونيكس المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

a45c3ed52297d362.description: About the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Senior Director FLS Design Assurance to lead Fire and Life Safety (FLS) design assurance for City Operations. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves ensuring that designs, construction activities, and proposed changes comply with approved FLS requirements and are operationally sound. The Senior Director will provide independent technical assurance from design development through project completion. Key Responsibilities Lead FLS design assurance across relevant City Operations assets, projects, and modifications. Establish governance, review criteria, and assurance processes for FLS design, construction activities, and technical changes. Review fire strategy, life-safety design, calculations, drawings, specifications, material submissions, and technical proposals for compliance and operational suitability. Lead FLS review of design changes, substitutions, value-engineering proposals, deviations, and contractor requests. Monitor construction activities to verify alignment with approved FLS designs, specifications, and agreed corrective actions. Provide technical direction to designers, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders on FLS requirements and assurance findings. Maintain clear design-review comments, decision records, risk acceptances, and closure evidence. Identify and escalate material design or construction risks that could affect compliance, asset readiness, or safe operation. Coordinate interfaces between design assurance, handover and commissioning, operational compliance, FM, and the Fire and Rescue Service. Specific Duties Develop and maintain FLS design-assurance procedures, review checklists, comment registers, and reporting dashboards. Plan and prioritize reviews based on asset criticality, project stage, and risk. Chair or support technical design-review and change-control meetings. Conduct targeted site inspections and construction monitoring of FLS-critical systems and passive fire-protection elements. Verify closure of design and construction comments before recommending progression to subsequent project or handover stages. Capture lessons learned and recurring design issues to improve future standards and specifications. Leadership and Functional Responsibilities Contribute to annual business planning, workforce planning, and budget management for the function. Lead, coach, and develop assigned teams and specialist service providers. Promote a culture of accountability, prevention, continual improvement, and evidence-based decision-making. Maintain accurate records and provide timely reports, presentations, and recommendations to City Operations leadership. Perform other related duties consistent with the role and business requirements. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in Fire and Life Safety design assurance or a related field.

a47024be5e6211ef.description: About the Role Power Tower Company is seeking a Civil Engineer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position open exclusively to Saudi nationals, focusing on the supervision of civil works for overhead transmission line (OHTL) projects. a4c3ee057c68277c.description: About Raytheon Raytheon, a business of RTX, is a global aerospace and defense company with over 100 years of experience in engineering and defense solutions. The company focuses on developing capabilities to connect and protect globally, supporting national and allied defense efforts. Role Overview The Hydraulic Actuator Technician position is a full-time role based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This critical role supports the sustainment of Royal Saudi Air Defense Forces (RSADF) systems, focusing on hydraulic system improvement and repair. The technician will provide technical assistance to existing customer personnel as covered under approved agreements. Key Responsibilities Perform maintenance and maintainability demonstrations for customers. Prepare and maintain records related to equipment failures. Participate in on-the-job training (OJT) programs and assist in enforcing safety policies, procedures, and standards. Repair and perform direct maintenance (DM) on military heavy/light vehicles, vehicle-mounted actuators, forklifts, and all hydraulic cylinders and valves. Set up and operate machine tools such as lathes, milling machines, and/or grinders. Perform test, inspection, and repair on hydraulic systems, verifying serviceability against prescribed standards. Execute adjustments and alignments for optimum performance. Identify faulty work practices and demonstrate proper maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair procedures and techniques. Provide on-site maintenance assistance as required. Complete maintenance and supply forms and prepare Patriot Field Reports (PFRs). Conduct assembly, disassembly, re-assembly, fabrication, repair, and/or inspection of electronic, electrical, and mechanical systems, chassis, and cables. Operate as a Wheel Vehicle driver for moving MEIs throughout the Depot. Qualifications and Requirements Typically requires an AA/AS degree or other 2-year post-high school training. Ability to follow basic work routines and standards through OJT for troubleshooting, fault isolation, and repair of Patriot Launching Station (LS) and AMG hydraulics, pneumatics, and mast structures. Experience in troubleshooting, fault isolation, repair, test, and checkout. General knowledge of maintenance workshop procedures. Work Environment This position is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and involves supporting Royal Saudi Air Defense Forces (RSADF) systems. The role requires collaboration with existing customer personnel and adherence to safety policies and procedures.

a4e4acf299be2f1b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهره الذييب للتجارة عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم الرئيس المباشر في تنظيم الأعمال الإدارية اليومية وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الدعم الإداري. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المساعد الإداري مجموعة من المهام الحيوية لضمان سلاسة العمليات الإدارية، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: متابعة تنفيذ التعليمات والقرارات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر. تنظيم البريد الوارد والصادر، سواء الورقي أو الإلكتروني، وتوزيعه على الأطراف المعنية أو الرد عليه وفقاً لتوجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية الواردة. تنظيم وحفظ الملفات والمعاملات بطريقة تسهل الرجوع إليها عند الحاجة. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها، بالإضافة إلى طباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر على الأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الدعم الإداري أو ما يعادله. القدرة على متابعة وتنفيذ القرارات الإدارية بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية عالية في إدارة البريد والمواعيد والملفات. إتقان أعمال الطباعة والتعامل مع المكالمات الهاتفية والاستفسارات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة كتابة وشفوياً. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بدوام كامل. سيعمل المساعد الإداري ضمن فريق يدعم الرئيس المباشر لضمان سير العمليات الإدارية بسلاسة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

a43e8d59d4d1558d.job_title: Partner Sales Director Global System Integrator (GSI)
a43e8d59d4d1558d.description: About Canonical Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to global enterprise and technology markets. The company publishes Ubuntu, a widely used platform in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Canonical operates with a global distributed collaboration model, employing over 1200 colleagues in more than 75 countries. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. The Role: Senior Partner Sales Manager, Global System Integrator (GSI) Canonical is seeking a Senior Partner Sales Manager, Global System Integrator (GSI) to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical to Canonical's growth plans, focusing on collaboration with GSI partners. The successful candidate will work closely with partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to facilitate Ubuntu-based solutions and opportunities. The role also involves assisting GSIs in building long-term digital transformation platforms using Ubuntu stacks and services. Key Responsibilities Build strategic relationships with partners at all levels and foster engagement with Ubuntu technology. Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms with partners. Collaborate with marketing, sales engineering, and product management to achieve targets and objectives, acting as a voice for partners. Lead executive interlocks between partners and the Canonical leadership team. Increase Canonical's market share and attach rate within partner engagements. Evangelize the partnership and lead business interactions from engineering to CxO level. Conduct customer workshops focused on specific initiatives. Attend sales events, deliver public presentations, and participate in executive engagements as coordinated by the Senior Director. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem. Knowledge of open-source selling models. Deep understanding of partner organizations and sales models, particularly with Global System Integrators. Ability to travel, sometimes internationally, up to 40% of the time. Compensation and Benefits Canonical considers geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation globally. Compensation is reviewed annually to recognize performance. In addition to base pay, the company offers a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. Additional benefits are provided to all team members, designed to meet local needs and ensure global fairness. Work Environment and Culture Canonical operates with a remote-first approach, with most colleagues working from home since its inception in 2004. Teams meet two to four times annually in person at various international locations for strategy and execution alignment. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a workplace free from discrimination, valuing diversity of experience, perspectives, and background.

a45648633bef1292.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أرمادا العالمية للمقاولات العامة عن رسام معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية إعداد وتعديل المخططات المعمارية والإنشائية، سواء يدويًا أو باستخدام البرمجيات المتخصصة، لضمان دقة الرسومات الهندسية وتوثيقها بشكل صحيح. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قراءة وتفسير مسودات المخططات والتصاميم المعمارية والرسوم الإنشائية بالتنسيق مع المهندس المختص. رسم وتحرير المخططات المعمارية والإنشائية يدويًا باستخدام أدوات الرسم المناسبة. إعداد المخططات الهندسية المعمارية والإنشائية والرسوم التنفيذية باستخدام برمجيات التصميم على الحاسوب. تدقيق الرسومات وتقديمها للمهندس المعماري، وإعداد الرسومات النهائية بناءً على التوجيهات. طباعة المخططات النهائية باستخدام برامج الحاسوب بالمقياس المطلوب. تصنيف وفهرسة وتوثيق وحفظ المخططات الهندسية والمعمارية بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الرسم المعماري أو ما يعادله. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الهندسية. إتقان الرسم اليدوي للمخططات المعمارية والإنشائية. إتقان استخدام برمجيات الرسم الهندسي على الحاسوب. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد الرسومات. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة لتصنيف وتوثيق المخططات. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في المشاريع الهندسية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

a4643a85b99fcc1f.description: Lead the procurement strategy and execution for construction, infrastructure, and capital projects, ensuring the effective sourcing of contractors, consultants, materials, and services in alignment with organizational objectives. a4d9fa6986001b17.description: About the Role Airbus ** is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer II (Process Engineer) to join the ME A320 department. The role involves translating design intent into technical instructions for product manufacturing and providing essential shop floor support. This includes managing the integrated Manufacturing Dossier, which covers all elements required for shop floor execution, such as engineering technical information, quality control, measurement tasks, components/parts, jigs & tools, maintenance tasks, and health & safety. Engineers at Airbus * Manufacturing facility work with production teams on all aspects of assembly, from concept to customer delivery. Drive the implementation of first installations, incorporating required shop floor feedback. Create, update, and prioritize routings, Bills of Material (BoM), and Standard Operating Instructions (SOI) based on shop floor needs, time calculations, and Work Preparation Golden Rules, in accordance with applicable ABP processes. Specify industrial asset requirements (Jigs, Tools, Tooling, Machines) for creation or modification, addressing standardization requests. Plan regular feedback loops with the Production Team. A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in development projects. Adept at managing multiple stakeholders and navigating political landscapes. Fastidious attention to detail. Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and manage diverse teams. a435eabfe5ff7dd7.description: About the Role Dow is seeking a Senior Customer Manager to drive revenue growth through catalyst, technology, and services sales for existing Univation customers across the Middle East. Coordinate with contractors and the wider project delivery team. Maintain accurate shift diaries, construction logs, and records of site activities. a4b3cae30274adab.description: About the Role The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is seeking a Business Continuity Specialist to join its team. This full-time role involves developing frameworks, policies, and operational plans to ensure business resilience. Conduct research and benchmark studies to identify the latest trends and best practices in business continuity applicable within ZATCA. Develop business continuity plans, frameworks, and related guidelines in coordination with the Planning and Monitoring function to ensure alignment with the Enterprise Risk Management strategy. Establish coordination mechanisms with the IT & Digitization function to track detected incidents and ensure proper handling of events. Conduct and run risk workshops with stakeholders to ensure awareness of all relevant changes and updates. Manage business continuity plan implementation to evaluate organizational risks and identify potential disruptions. Conduct periodic tests on business continuity plan implementation and perform business impact analysis across ZATCA’s functions to safeguard readiness. Prepare awareness and training sessions for business continuity to improve functions’ risk capabilities. Perform periodical audits to maintain ISO 22301 certification, specifying requirements for implementing, maintaining, and improving the business continuity management system. Follow all relevant policies, processes, and standard operating procedures. Operational Duties Deliver training courses on business continuity management. Assist in developing team members' competencies related to business continuity. Support strategic decision-making in the absence of the director. Participate in formulating the management’s strategy and objectives. Help formalize relevant plans to align with strategic directions. a46c9d5ed76cd73e.description: Job description Stage - Ingénieur-e Industrialisation / Costing & Amélioration des Outils de Chiffrage F/H Stage 6 mois Etudiant Temps complet Safran Additive Manufacturing Campus (SAMC) est une entreprise du groupe Safran, pôle d'excellence 100% dédié à la Fabrication Additive. Le campus a ouvert ses portes en octobre 2021 et rassemble en un seul lieu les meilleurs experts, les matériels et les machines dernière génération dans le but de : • Fluidifier et accélérer le partage des connaissances et savoir-faire. • Servir la performance de tous les clients de toutes les sociétés du Groupe. • Préparer le futur en se dotant d'infrastructures innovantes pour notre compétitivité. Cette nouvelle technologie permet aux machines d'être plus performantes et d'obtenir des pièces plus légères qui répond au premier objectif de Safran : la décarbonisation. Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités de fabrication additive, Safran Additive Manufacturing Campus réalise régulièrement des Propositions Techniques et Financières (PTF) pour des projets de développement et de production. La robustesse et la fiabilité de ces chiffrages constituent un enjeu majeur pour garantir la compétitivité et la rentabilité des futurs programmes. Afin d'améliorer la performance de nos méthodes de costing et d'harmoniser les pratiques de chiffrage, nous recherchons un-e stagiaire ingénieur-e motivé-e pour contribuer à l'évolution des outils, bases de données et méthodologies utilisés par les équipes d'industrialisation. Profil recherché • Étudiant-e en école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en génie industriel, industrialisation, production ou gestion de projet industriel. • Intérêt pour les problématiques technico-économiques et l'analyse des coûts. Une appétence pour le domaine aéronautique est un plus. • Bonne maîtrise d'Excel et des outils d'analyse de données. La maitrise des outils Power BI /SAP est un plus • Esprit d'analyse, rigueur et autonomie. • Aisance relationnelle pour travailler avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (industrialisation, méthodes, production, achats, experts techniques). Ce que ce stage vous apportera : • Une vision complète du processus d'élaboration des offres techniques et financières dans un environnement industriel de haute technologie. • Une immersion au cœur des enjeux d'industrialisation liés à la fabrication additive. • Des interactions avec de nombreux métiers de l'entreprise. • Une expérience concrète en optimisation des processus, analyse de coûts et pilotage de projets d'amélioration continue. L'objectif principal du stage est de constituer une base de données et d'améliorer les méthodes et outils de calcul des coûts utilisés pour l'établissement des Propositions Techniques et Financières. Les travaux porteront sur les deux composantes majeures du chiffrage : 1. Amélioration du calcul des coûts non récurrents (NRC) Les coûts non récurrents correspondent aux coûts d'ingénierie, de développement, d'industrialisation et de mise en œuvre nécessaires avant le lancement de la production. Vous contribuerez à : • Analyser l'outil NRC actuellement utilisé et évaluer son adéquation avec les besoins des projets de fabrication additive. • Proposer des évolutions des modèles de chiffrage NRC afin de mieux refléter les activités réelles réalisées lors des développements. • Intégrer des postes budgétaires optionnels liés aux risques techniques identifiés lors de la construction des offres. • Mettre à jour la documentation et les règles de gestion associées. 2. Optimisation du calcul des coûts récurrents (RC) Les coûts récurrents correspondent aux coûts de fabrication associés à chaque pièce produite. Dans ce cadre, vous serez amené-e à : • Structurer et consolider une base de données des coûts de développement et de production des pièces en recensant et analysant les coûts des opérations internes et des prestations externes • Définir des référentiels de coûts par famille de pièces et par alliage en collaboration avec les leaders techniques, le bureau des méthodes, les équipes industrialisation et production. • Harmoniser les règles de calcul et les hypothèses de chiffrage utilisées par les différents acteurs et améliorer l'outil de costing RC existant. • Rédiger un mode opératoire permettant de standardiser l'utilisation de l'outil. Les livrables attendus sont : • Base de données consolidée des coûts RC. • Règles et standards de chiffrage harmonisés. • Amélioration des outils de costing RC et NRC. • Modes opératoires et guides utilisateurs associés. • Recommandations pour la prise en compte des risques dans les propositions commerciales. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

a440f58a0db1abd6.description: About the Role AkzoNobel is seeking a Process Engineer to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region.
